purpose: Record an invalid host-coordinate click attempt while validating the mouse recapture path.

test.target_intended: MAME clone window PID 274368, single click on File Manager bin icon
test.result: The resulting host pointer coordinates were outside MAME and over XChat; the click did not test MAME mouse recapture.
test.host_ui: A single click may have changed the active XChat view. No text was typed or sent. The XChat window was already active again after restoring the previous MAME minimized state; the exact previous XChat view was not recreated.
test.mame_window_restored: Minimized/unmapped, matching its state before the attempted click test.

limits: Do not count this as a pass or failure of the capture hook. Calibrate the absolute X11 client coordinates and verify the window PID immediately before any future synthetic click.
